verdict.rationale: Grafana's alerting system supports continuously evaluated (recurring) alert rules and GitOps/CI-CD provisioning of dashboards and configs, which are forms of recurring automation, and Grafana now exposes an official MCP server so AI agents can interact with the platform. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler exposed to AI-native users, nor documentation showing an agent using the MCP server to create or manage recurring jobs/workflows end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-driven scheduling/automation workflow examples, a dedicated job/workflow scheduling API beyond alert rule evaluation, independent confirmation of MCP-based recurring task creation.
